leakage_note: No feature is a function of distance to a known mine, and lat/lng are excluded from the feature set. The previous pipeline derived every spectral value from proximity to the mine coordinates, which are the positive labels.
lithology_note: GSI lithology is NOT included: bhukosh.gsi.gov.in and geoportal.gsi.gov.in were unreachable. Omitted rather than substituted with an invented value.
sources: Sentinel-2 L2A surface reflectance via Microsoft Planetary Computer
